messages.text:
"A 3D HD open world game with various types of vehicles, and pedestrians. Create a character with multiple different clothing items, scars, blemishes, glasses, hats, shoes, underwear, swimsuits. Various types of animals such as dogs, cats, birds, squirrels, rabbits, deer, doe, possums, racoons, bulls, lizards, cows, and chickens. An accessible cell phone that has options and settings including a map of the city contacts you can call in game. I want the game to be able to be played online with others or offline without any differences in gameplay.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.
"
